marketing_description: The Milwaukee M12 Series Gangbox Rapid Charger is designed to charge packs up to 40% faster to reduce downtime on the jobsite. This rapid charger works with all M18 and M12 batteries, featuring simultaneous charging for M12 and M18 batteries and sequential charging to minimize management time. Additionally, it includes a pass-through plug to conserve outlet space and is mountable for easy storage.
